div.div: LLM: large language model. PII: personally identifiable information, such as emails and phone numbers. OTel: OpenTelemetry. NAT: network address translation. vLLM: the open-source model server from P1. L4: the NVIDIA GPU it runs on. KEDA: Kubernetes Event-driven Autoscaling. Presidio: Microsoft's open-source PII detector. OpenAI-compatible: the same API shape as OpenAI's, so apps need no changes. Virtual key: a team's own gateway key, never a provider key.
